sentence: This project expands data storage for high-performance computing so researchers can manage, analyze, and share large datasets.
This project studies finfish and shellfish fisheries to find ways to manage them so that fishing stays sustainable.
This project builds single-photon detectors that detect light with very high efficiency and tries to lower their dark current.
This project builds a method that combines theoretical models with machine learning to forecast ecosystem regime shifts.
This project studies the physics that comes from the geometry of string theory, and uses machine learning to help.
This project builds methods that compress immersive media and send it over wireless networks, using learning-based algorithms.
This project builds standards and metrics so that biofoundries in different countries can produce reliable and comparable data.
This project studies how adaptive nonlinear oscillators that run near transitions in their motion can be used to process information.
This project uses high-speed cameras to film sprites above thunderclouds and find out which physical processes are involved.
This project studies how body size shaped the way extinct amphibian relatives walked and swam, using fossils and computer simulations.
This project studies how the composition of rubber nanocomposites and the printing settings affect parts made by direct ink writing.
This project studies how nanoparticles adhered to leukocyte surfaces change how the cells deform and migrate from blood to inflamed tissues.
This project studies how to 3D print products from multiple materials and how the printing process affects their properties.
This project builds materials from biochar that trap microcystin in drinking water and uses bacteria to break it down.
This project explores how physical science can help advance the study of biological aging.
This project builds a chip that makes and detects large-scale entanglement among many quantum modes of light.
